lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments observed on the torso; spacing is approximately equidistant in the mid-section with narrowing density toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 7th stripe from the anterior, splitting into a Y-shape at the mid-dorsal lateral position; secondary convergence observed on the 10th stripe.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripe 4 terminates abruptly in the mid-lateral region; stripe 12 is composed of three discrete dashed segments that do not intersect the dorsal or ventral boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-density cluster of 4 circular white spots located on the lower posterior haunch, centered vertically between the tail base and hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the upper hind limb align to form a semi-connected horizontal geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Two white facial spots located inferior to the eye; prominent white patch at the base of the throat/lower neck region.
